facts.business: Cosmo First is the world's largest producer of thermal lamination films and second-largest producer of specialty label films globally, also operating in BOPP films, technical films, rigid packaging, synthetic paper, premium window films (Cosmo Sunshield), paint protection films (Cosmo PPF), and petcare (Zigly).

segments.name: Packaging Films (BOPP, Thermal Lamination, Specialty Label, Technical Films, Rigid Packaging, Synthetic Paper)
Consumer Products (Cosmo Sunshield Window Films, Cosmo PPF Paint Protection Films)

key_risks: Global economic disruption from Middle East conflict
Price risk from investments classified at fair value through OCI or FVTPL
